title: Geoarchaeological evidence for the construction, irrigation, cultivation, and resilience of 15th–18th century AD terraced landscape at Engaruka, Tanzania
lineage: Brief paraphrased research notes; not a source copy.

passages.note: The researchers interpret check-dam construction and captured alluvial sediments at Engaruka, together with evidence for variable irrigation. They associate the wider landscape with the 15th–18th centuries; no exact construction date of each wall is established, and reasons for abandonment and climatic resilience remain uncertain.
